name: transport
description: mwf ITransport implementations. On device (this PlatformIO view): gRPC-over-HTTP/2 via the portable grpc_h2 core + vendored nghttp2 + WiFiClientSecure (mbedTLS, ALPN h2). The desktop grpc++/libcurl twin under src/ + esp/host/ is CMake-only and excluded here.
keywords: mwf, temporal, grpc, http2, nghttp2, esp32
